implementation.radix2: Jitted iterative butterflies with JAX twiddle exponential arithmetic, static bit reversal, no FFT calls.
implementation.bluestein: Jitted chirp convolution padded to power-of-two >=2*n-1,2 FFTs+1 IFFT; exact integer phase residues before JAX chirp arithmetic.
implementation.import: Lazy optional JAX; module import does not initialize device.
implementation.dtype: Complex64/128 retained (caller must enable x64 for128); real32/64 promoted to matching complex.

families: negative-sign input tone with positive output peak
tests.reference: Independent numpy complex128 positive dense matrix DFT.

limitations: Tested locally on JAX0.11.2 CPU;0.4.20 compatibility uses basic public APIs but was not locally executed.
These are classical explanatory baselines, not the published saving network or a speedup claim.
No remote execution, benchmark, plotting or dependency edits in this scope.
